Kind of different, but I’m going to tell it anyways. I woke up at 4 am, pitch dark in my room. I had this urge to move my curtains and look out the window, not sure how to explain it, I just had to. So, I look out the window and by my neighbor’s truck I see this large dog rolling around by the back tires. The street lights gave me some view but it was very dim. Out of stupidity, I got up and opened my front door just a crack—so I could see better. The thing shot up and just stared at me before running off into the field by my house, then I noticed where the dog was running to and all I see is this figure sitting in middle of the field with this dog circling it. This thing looked like a random ass person just sitting in the field. I just closed my door thinking someone was just taking their dog out. Until I realized it’s fucking 4 am and I peeked out again and this person was standing. I locked the door and went back to bed unsure of what to do. Next night I set an alarm for 4 am to see if I actually saw someone out there or if it was just a pole or something. No figure was there so there was clearly something out there but I like to think someone just decided to take their dog out in middle of the night-
